metadata.summary: Sonay Kartal is the new British No 1 after her remarkable run to the Wuhan Open final where she was narrowly beaten by Poland's Maja Chwalinska in three sets.
metadata.content: Sonay Kartal: What next for new British No 1 after 'unbelievable week' in run to the final at Wuhan Open | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Sonay Kartal: What next for new British No 1 after 'unbelievable week' in run to the final at Wuhan Open Britain's Sonay Kartal enjoyed the best week of her career so far as she surprisingly made the final at the Wuhan Open; Kartal only recently returned from injury, so what is her potential and can she kick on? Watch the Japan Open all this week, live on Sky Sports Tennis Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Sunday 18 October 2026 17:27, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Wuhan Open final between Sonay Kartal and Maja Chwalinska. Sonay Kartal is the new British No 1 after her remarkable run to the Wuhan Open final where she was narrowly beaten by Poland's Maja Chwalinska in three sets. Kartal became just the second Briton, after Johanna Konta, to play in a WTA 1000 final with superb wins over Tokyo Olympic champion Belinda Bencic, two-time Grand Slam finalist Jasmine Paolini, world No 6 Elina Svitolina and former French Open champion Jelena Ostapenko. It is arguably the most impressive tournament performance from a British female player since Emma Raducanu won the 2021 US Open, particularly given Kartal only returned to action last month following six months out due to a stress fracture in her back.
